High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Rajeev Upadhyay - Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.
The applicant has filed this first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 02-11-2022 by Police Station Deepankheda District Vidisha in connection with Crime No.139/2019 registered for offence under Sections 363, 368, 376(2)(n), 302 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

2. It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that false case has been registered against him and he is suffering confinement since 02-11-2022 and material prosecution witnesses Badi Bai (PW-5), Vimla Bai (PW-6) and Shivcharan (PW-7) have been examined and they did not support the story of prosecution and declared hostile.
Even otherwise, chance of tampering with witnesses is remote by now.
Allegations are based on circumstantial evidence and in such cases, motive assumes importance.
No recovery has been made from the possession of applicant.
Chain of circumstances is broken and it does not lead uninterruptedly to the applicant.

Co-accused Anish and Wasim have already been enlarged on bail and it is highly improbable that prosecutrix who was out of her home for more than two months, was never noticed by the family members and they did not file any complaint in this regard.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial and as and when required he will appear before the trial Court.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the submission advanced by learned counsel for the parties and the fact that material prosecution witnesses have been examined, but without commenting on the merits of the case, it is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

6. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.
7. Application stands allowed and disposed of.

8. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
